opening.argument: The presentation solicits Bitcoin-funded mining-pool participation, offering shares beginning at $500 and linking them to projected passive earnings over a stated mining period. It also presents a recruitment-based compensation structure: participants can earn Bitcoin from left-and-right team credits and percentage payments tied to personally referred members. The solicitation extends to bypassing a joining restriction through Facebook and collecting a viewer's name and email to open an account. These combined payment, return, recruitment, and access claims establish the character of the offer, while the records do not establish whether any promised returns, commissions, or workaround were completed.
